pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: what percent of total donation value comes from people who gave more than once, and how many repeat donors are there
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH TotalDonations AS (SELECT SUM(Amount) AS TotalAmount FROM donations), RepeatDonors AS (SELECT Donor, COUNT(*) AS DonationCount, SUM(Amount) AS TotalDonorAmount FROM donations GROUP BY Donor HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT (SUM(TotalDonorAmount) / NULLIF(NULLIF((SELECT TotalAmount FROM TotalDonations), 0), 0)) * 100 AS PercentOfTotalFromRepeatDonors, COUNT(*) AS NumberOfRepeatDonors FROM RepeatDonors

CURRENT QUESTION:
what percent of total donation value comes from people who gave more than once, and how many repeat donors are there
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH TotalDonations AS (
    SELECT SUM(Amount) AS TotalAmount
    FROM donations
),
RepeatDonors AS (
    SELECT Donor, COUNT(*) AS DonationCount, SUM(Amount) AS TotalDonorAmount
    FROM donations
    GROUP BY Donor
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
    (SUM(TotalDonorAmount) / NULLIF((SELECT TotalAmount FROM TotalDonations), 0)) * 100 AS PercentOfTotalFromRepeatDonors,
    COUNT(*) AS NumberOfRepeatDonors
FROM RepeatDonors;
```
